project_context.app_type: Marketing Landing Page for SaaS (Crypto Payment Gateway)
project_context.design_philosophy: Institutional Trust meets Web3 Kinetics. Zero generic AI slop. Swiss precision with terminal-inspired technical details, inspired by Stripe's 2026 engineer-centric layouts.
project_context.tech_stack_rules: Next.js Pages Router, Material UI (MUI) v5, TypeScript. STRICTLY NO TAILWIND. Use MUI `sx` prop, `styled` components, and pure CSS @keyframes.

headings.rules: H1-H6. Use negative letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em). Never use default bold, prefer distinct weights like 300 (Light) or 800 (Black). Capitalize strategically.

body.rules: Clean, highly legible. 16px to 18px base size. 1.6 line height. Used for paragraphs, subtitles, and general UI text.

mono.rules: Used for data points, tags, overlines, and code snippets. Extremely technical vibe.

colors.strategy: Swiss & High-Contrast + Performance Pro. No generic SaaS blue. We use Deep Obsidian, Pure White, and Electric 'Volt' Green for kinetic energy. Color is function.

spacing_and_layout.container: Max width 1400px. Unusually generous padding. Sections should have 120px to 160px vertical padding (e.g., `py: { xs: 10, md: 20 }` in MUI).
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use CSS Grid via MUI `sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(12, 1fr)', gap: 3 }}`. Avoid standard equal-width cards. Mix `gridColumn: 'span 8'` and `span 4`.
spacing_and_layout.card_surfaces: No soft drop shadows. Flat surfaces, 1px sharp borders. Border radius max 16px. On hover, apply a technical '-translate-y-1' and a sharp colored shadow, e.g., `boxShadow: '4px 4px 0px var(--accent-color)'`.

hero.composition: Massive typography left-aligned. 'Unbounded' font. Right side features a floating Glassmorphic terminal window showcasing an instant settlement API call.
hero.signature_moment: Instead of blobs, use an SVG 'Tracing Beam' or geometric grid background. A bold button that says 'Start processing — 0.7%' in Volt Green.

compliance_strip.composition: A high-contrast strip (inverted background) with grayscale logos of SOC2, GDPR, Chainalysis, and non-custodial badges. Slow infinite CSS marquee.

product_showcase.composition: A 3-step interactive sticky-scroll or auto-playing tab system. Step 1: Customer QR Checkout. Step 2: Instant Settlement to wallet. Step 3: Developer Dashboard. Build these as abstract UI mockups using MUI boxes and typography, not images.

supported_chains.composition: Horizontal rail. Very large IBM Plex Mono text overlapping or crisp, monochromatic SVG icons of the 13 chains. Minimalist, highly technical.

stat_wall.composition: Stripe-inspired density. 4 massive numbers taking up the screen width. E.g., '$0' (Setup), '0.7%' (Fee), '< 2s' (Settlement), '13' (Chains). Use 'Unbounded' 800 weight, huge font sizes.

value_props.composition: 3 minimalist cards. Top border of the card acts as a progress bar or highlights in Volt Green on hover.

use_cases_bento.problem_solved: Replaces generic stock photos with a product-forward Bento Grid.
use_cases_bento.composition:
A 12-column CSS grid. 
- Card 1 (Span 8): 'Online Stores' with a mock checkout UI component built in MUI.
- Card 2 (Span 4): 'SaaS' with a code snippet showing API subscription logic.
- Card 3 (Span 4): 'Creators' with a mock donation widget.
- Card 4 (Span 8): 'Freelancers' with a sleek invoice table mockup.
Hover states should trigger micro-animations within the mockups.

fee_calculator.composition: MUI Slider with a custom thumb. Left side: slider and input. Right side: Two vertical bars (HTML divs). Dynopay's bar is tiny and Volt Green. Stripe/PayPal's bar is huge and red/gray. The bars dynamically resize via inline styles as the slider moves to visually show savings visceral.

testimonials.composition: Editorial layout. Ditch the standard carousel. Use a masonry layout or large, commanding quotes. Include avatar, name, and a 5-star visual.
testimonials.avatars: Use the provided image URLs in the media section.

faq.composition: MUI Accordion. Override default styles: background transparent, `boxShadow: 'none'`, 1px bottom border. Icon is a simple '+' that rotates to '-'.

final_cta.composition: Deep Obsidian background regardless of light/dark mode. Huge text: 'The old system is slow. Dynopay is instant.' Volt Green CTA button.

motion_guidelines.hover_states: Interactive elements MUST have distinct hover states. E.g., `transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease`.
motion_guidelines.scroll_reveal: Implement a simple `IntersectionObserver` hook to apply a `.visible` class that triggers a fade-up animation for sections as they enter the viewport.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, and major sections MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white text on deep obsidian meets APCA/WCAG standards. Volt Green on white must be used carefully; prefer it as a background with black text.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE TAILWIND CSS. The project uses MUI v5 and `sx` styling. Do not install or configure Tailwind.
Configure a custom MUI Theme (`createTheme`) mapping these typography and color rules to `theme.palette` and `theme.typography`.
Implement the Use Cases section strictly as a Bento Grid composed of MUI components acting as mini-UI mockups. NO STOCK PHOTOS. NO EXCEPTIONS.
For the fee calculator, write custom React state logic linked to a Slider and dynamically style the height/width of comparison bars to make the impact obvious.
Ensure the layout is perfectly responsive using MUI's `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg` breakpoints in `sx`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break that habit. Use the specified 'Unbounded' and 'IBM Plex Mono' fonts.
Apply 'Swiss & High-Contrast' design principles: dense data, crisp 1px borders, and striking neon accents against obsidian or pure white.
Never use AI assistant emojis. Use professional, monochromatic SVG icons (e.g., from MUI Icons).
Every section must feel highly deliberate and 'institutional' yet technically advanced.
